source: bench/rulebook-nfl.mjs on data/post/nfl, 184k showdown lineups 2026-09-10..09-28; KEEP = |t| >= 3, same sign both halves, 300+ each side

rules.rule: salary at or under $50,000
rules.evidence: DraftKings rejects the upload

rules.rule: no two identical lineups from this account in one contest
rules.evidence: a copy can only split with yourself

rules.rule: roster a quarterback
captain is not a kicker or DST
DST must not face your own QB
no kicker
rules.evidence: -46% vs +4%, t -6.0, lift 0.50; the user had one in half his $100-299 entries

rules.rule: 5-1 team split
QB with one of his pass catchers
roster a DST
captain owned 10% or more
rules.evidence: under 10%: -44% vs +9%, t -5.6; the user's captains averaged 7.5-12.6%

rules.rule: captain is not a TE
rules.evidence: full archive t -8.8

rules.rule: ownership sum under 180% (220%+ is the losing zone)
leave $1,000 or more
rules.evidence: t 3.2 full archive; winners leave $450-525 on average

rules.rule: sim ROI in the top half of the field
expected copies in the field under 2
rules.evidence: bench/fit-dup-nfl.mjs: showdown fields duplicate heavily; the user's showdown entries were duplicated 69-100% vs winners 23-32%

rules.rule: CPT QB with two or more of his WR/TE
rules.evidence: ETR: 65% of winning CPT QB lineups carry 2-3 same-team WR/TE; 5% carry none

rules.rule: CPT WR with at most one other WR/TE from his team
rules.evidence: ETR: 88.5% of winning CPT WR lineups; two or more same-team pass catchers 9%

rules.rule: CPT RB with at most two same-team WR/TE, usually with his QB
rules.evidence: ETR: 3 same-team WR/TE with CPT RB 3%; his QB in 61% of winners

rules.rule: CPT TE with his QB
rules.evidence: ETR: 89% of winning CPT TE lineups

rules.rule: CPT QB or WR with at least one opposing WR/TE
rules.evidence: ETR: 80% (CPT QB) and 84% (CPT WR) of winners

rules.rule: DST with three or more teammates and at most three opponents
rules.evidence: ETR: 79% of winning DST lineups have 3+ teammates, 89% have 3 or fewer opponents; DST as the lone bring-back in 5-1 wins 0.4%

rules.rule: at most two kickers and DSTs combined
rules.evidence: ETR: 3+ K/DST land in top-1% lineups 1.1% of the time

rules.rule: in a 5-1 or 4-2, the captain comes from the heavy side
rules.evidence: ETR: 95% of winning 5-1s and 77% of winning 4-2s

rules.rule: in a 5-1, the QB from the five side is in the lineup
rules.evidence: ETR: 95% of winning onslaughts

rules.rule: captain salary $10,500 or more (or a clear ceiling case)
rules.evidence: ETR: winning captains average $13,012; cheap captains that won beat their median 2.6x

rules.rule: at least one kicker or DST in the flex
rules.evidence: ETR 2025 sims: six skill players is the weakest configuration (-17% sim ROI single-entry); K+DST together +16.9% for pros. Conflicts with our 'no kicker' rule - under test
